short: Whisper-Flamingo is a well-engineered combination of prior parts; its clean LRS3 gain disappears at beam 1, and one model trails per-pair models in noisy translation (20.5 vs 20.8 BLEU).
position: Changed M06 (gated decoder fusion), M03 (frozen recognizer plus new layers) and M08 (one model for transcription and En-X): all standard. M12 standard: single runs, recreated noise files, beam-15 baseline.
